Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

Diego — good catch. Quick note on the ephemeral-host approach: Redwood can provision an ephemeral Zoom host for one-off demos that does not require the customer's Zoom SSO to match — it's essentially a transient meeting owner that prevents the "request host" prompt and avoids organizer-alias shadowing across calendar systems. Two small implementation notes:

- We'll create the meeting with "join before host" disabled but pre-assign the Redwood moderator identity so customers won't be blocked.
- I'll attach a one-page stub with steps for your events admin to replace the existing event with the clean ICS and to copy the Zoom link into the event description.

Attachment: redwood-ephemeral-host-guide.pdf (stub)

Diego — I went ahead and created the temp meeting: https://zoom.us/j/965-012-3345 (passcode: 4829). Please paste this into the event and tell Alex which invite to keep/remove.
